summary: Decent Holding Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 3, 2026, covering the six months ended April 30, 2026. The filing contains unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, and related exhibits. No special-situations transaction or event is described; it is a routine periodic results filing under the 1934 Act. The report was signed by CEO Haicheng Xu and includes standard forward-looking statements. There are no deal terms, advisor references, or structural mechanics; accordingly, this is not a special situation.
